title: Fotona vs CO2 Laser: Which to Choose?
h1: Fotona vs CO2 laser: gentle renewal or deep resurfacing?
desc: Fotona vs fractional CO2 laser compared: depth, downtime, results for scars, wrinkles and laxity, suitability and prices at Skin & Laser Dubai.
answer: Fotona combines Er:YAG and Nd:YAG for tightening and gentle resurfacing with a day or two of pinkness (from AED 999 + VAT). Fractional CO2 resurfaces much more deeply for acne scars, deeper wrinkles and sun damage, with 5 to 7 days of recovery (AED 3,000 + VAT for the face). Fotona suits maintenance and early ageing; CO2 suits bigger change.
facts: Fotona 1 to 2 days; CO2 5 to 7 days
body:
## Which to choose

- Deep acne scars or wrinkles, with time to recover: CO2
- Laxity, pores and texture with little downtime: Fotona
- Darker skin: usually gentler Fotona settings first

## Results

CO2 gives larger improvement in fewer sessions. Fotona builds results gradually over a short series. Both keep improving as collagen forms over 3 to 6 months.
faq: Yes, in a staged plan your doctor designs.
Fotona has less downtime and lower risk; CO2 needs more careful aftercare.
Which is better for acne scars?
CO2 for deeper scars; Fotona or Morpheus8 for milder ones.
